name: Napkin AI
tagline: Turns text into diagrams, charts and visuals that you can edit and export.
about: Napkin AI reads a passage of text and suggests visuals that explain it. You pick one, edit it and export it for slides or documents.
pros: Turns pasted text into several visual options in seconds.
Visuals are editable and export in common formats.
cons: Best for simple concept visuals, not detailed technical diagrams.
The free plan has a credit limit.
